en.based-on-app-description: {app} is built on {upstream}, the open-source budgeting app by {author}, licensed under GPL-3.0. Tap to see the original credits, translators and acknowledgements.
en.totals-per-currency-description: Show balances in each currency separately instead of converting them to your base currency
en.account-groups-description: Organize accounts into groups with their own totals
en.delete-account-group-description: Accounts in this group will not be deleted, they will move to Other Accounts.
en.no-account-groups: No groups yet. Add one to organize your accounts, like Banks, Cash or Cards.
en.no-accounts-in-group: No accounts in this group yet
en.frequent-account-description: Show as a quick pick when adding transactions. Other accounts stay under the show-all button.
en.location-tagging-description: Save where each new transaction was added. Only the city is shown.
en.photo-icons-hint: Use your own picture, like a bank logo or a photo of a card. It is cropped to a square and saved with the icon.
en.base-currency-description: Totals, budgets and charts are converted into this currency
en.native-transaction-amounts-description: Show each transaction in its account's currency, with the converted amount underneath
en.currency-view-description: Show only the accounts in one currency, with exact totals
en.select-account-to-save: Choose the account for this transaction
en.default-account-description: Used only when Ameen can't ask, like links from other apps, the home-screen widget and imports
en.currency-label-description: Show the currency after account names, e.g. ICICI (INR)
en.daftar-description: Every transaction in one sheet: search, filter, sort and review
en.daftar-wide-screen: Daftar needs a wider screen. Open it on a computer or tablet, at app.ameen.zaidshaikh.com/daftar.
en.daftar-save-failed: {failed} of {count} transactions couldn't be saved. They're still marked as changed.
en.daftar-unsaved-description: You have {count} unsaved changes. Leaving discards them.
